caption: The video captures a top-down view of a clear glass measuring cup resting on a white cloth printed with a teal leaf pattern, beneath a watermark in the upper right. Inside the cup, green matcha liquid holds floating powder clumps, surface bubbles, and a pale patch. A white-gloved hand grips a metal balloon whisk from the top, while a second gloved hand steadies the cup's handle at the right edge. The whisk sweeps in a continuous stirring motion through the bottom and center, folding the dry powder and pale patch into the liquid. Surface bubbles become incorporated and less distinct as the separated mixture thickens into a more homogeneous green paste, and a mound of partially mixed powder is worked into the surrounding liquid. The holding hand remains fixed while the whisking hand shifts within the cup.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
